reasons.plausibility: Adding Si or B to a metal-metalloid glass former often improves glass-forming ability, but the proposed mechanism ('nucleation site inhibitor') is vague and the hypothesis does not explain why this would work in a complex high-entropy alloy already containing 20 at.% P, making the scientific basis questionable.
reasons.testability: The test specifies a falsification condition (slow cooling) and clear measurements (XRD/TEM, DSC), but the falsification criterion is poorly chosen because the hypothesis itself predicts failure under slow cooling, so the test would not decisively falsify the claim.
reasons.usefulness: The idea of minor metalloid additions is a common strategy, but the hypothesis lacks specificity (which element, exact amount) and does not engage with the prior thermal instability of the reported alloy, limiting its practical guidance for a researcher.
